summary: Portal-gate blink control: a three-mana command-zone doorway that repeatedly crosses strange ETB creatures and tap-ability portal artifacts, protecting them from removal on the way through.

tags.name: blink
tags.reason: Abuelo blinks a creature or artifact every turn from the command zone, backed by Teleportation Circle, Conjurer's Closet, Erratic Portal, Venser, Planar Guide, and five one-shot blink spells.

tags.name: etb effects
tags.reason: Twenty creatures plus Panharmonicon give the blink engine repeatable removal, selection, card advantage, recursion, protection, and mass bounce.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.reason: Literal portal artifacts, two transforming gateways, Panharmonicon, Tezzeret's activation discount, Prototype Portal copies, and a commander who blinks artifacts to untap them.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: Bounce, prison Auras, Floodgate, Renet, Planar Guide, and Wall of Tears control combat and permanent development at instant speed.

tags.name: flash
tags.reason: Renet, Whitemane Lion, Unyielding Gatekeeper's disguise flip, Justiciar's Portal, Portal Manipulator, and Emergence Zone support opponent-turn play, but flash is no longer a scored goal.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Portal Manipulator, Coercive Portal, and Phyrexian Portal still create table decisions, but politics is no longer a major axis.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: The mana package exists to reach the expensive portals, but it is support rather than the deck's identity.

tags.name: spell copy
tags.reason: Invasion of Vryn and See Double can copy the right spell at the right moment, but the list is not primarily a copy deck.

tags.name: stax
tags.reason: Mirror of Life Trapping delays every creature opponents cast while this deck's blinked creatures never feed it. It is the only prison piece left.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Chrome Host Seedshark, Aether Channeler, Multiversal Recruitment, and Sunder the Gateway make bodies, but the token plan is now support.

tags.name: battles
tags.reason: Invasion of Vryn remains a useful threshold card, but battles are now incidental.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Mirror of Life Trapping and Phyrexian Portal add uncertainty, but the symmetrical chaos artifact is gone.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Portal to Phyrexia can reanimate opposing creatures, but theft is incidental.
